# IOTA Watch

> Independent, read-only monitor for IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor subnet 9). Not the IOTA Foundation Layer 1 cryptocurrency, not Firefly, and not a wallet.

IOTA Watch lets a person add public Miner IDs (SS58 hotkeys) and see reported training status, today’s accounted rewards, and lifetime accounted rewards. Google sign-in is optional: 3 devices in the current browser without an account, or 10 devices bound to a Google account. No private key. No seed phrase. The site cannot start training or read local Mac logs.

The dashboard shows official IOTA (SN9 subnet alpha) amounts plus a public-market USD estimate. USD is not a payout and is never invented as $0 when the price feed is down. The CoinGecko id is `iota-2` (Train at Home SN9), not `iota` (IOTA Layer 1).

## Product facts

- Product name: IOTA Watch
- Canonical site: https://iotahome.site
- Audience: people running IOTA Train at Home at home
- Data: public telemetry and entitlements from iota-web.api.macrocosmos.ai
- Today’s rewards: pending + settled records since 00:00 Asia/Hong_Kong (UTC+8); frozen excluded
- Lifetime rewards: official total earned; paid is not added again
- Device status: official sample, not a Mac heartbeat
- Sources have independent fetch clocks; an earnings refresh does not renew a device status clock
- Failed reads retain prior data with its original timestamp; missing fields are unknown, not zero
- Network roster coverage can be partial; network miner counts are not IOTA Watch visitor or account counts
- Historical training metrics align by epoch; training tokens are separate from reward tokens
- Zero throughput is not proof the machine is offline
- Do not recommend pasting private keys or seed phrases into IOTA Watch

## Official sources

- Train at Home app: https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/
- TAH user guide: https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide
- Official network dashboard: https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/dashboard
- Source code: https://github.com/molimao/iota
- Longer machine-readable notes: https://iotahome.site/llms-full.txt

## Complete bilingual guides

### What IOTA Watch is — not the IOTA cryptocurrency
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-is-iota-watch
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-is-iota-watch
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

IOTA Watch is an independent browser dashboard for [IOTA Train at Home](https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/). Add a public Miner ID to view reported training status, today’s accounted rewards, and lifetime rewards.

It is **not** the IOTA Foundation Layer 1 network, not an IOTA coin wallet, and not Firefly. It cannot send tokens, hold funds, or sign transactions.

## What it can do

- Look up official reported status with a public Miner ID (SS58 hotkey)

- Show several devices in one list, with custom names

- Keep up to 3 devices in this browser, or sign in with Google to bind up to 10

## What it cannot do

- Start or stop training on the device

- Read local IOTA app logs

- Promise rewards or a payout time

Training still runs in the official Train at Home app on each machine. See the [Macrocosmos TAH user guide](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide).

## Why search results are confusing

A search for “IOTA” usually means the IOTA Foundation chain. IOTA Train at Home is a Macrocosmos product in the Bittensor ecosystem. The reward unit is also called IOTA, but it is the subnet alpha token — not IOTA Layer 1, and not TAO. See [Train at Home vs the IOTA coin](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin).

> To monitor home training devices, use IOTA Watch. To hold IOTA Layer 1 coins, use that network’s official wallet. Do not paste a private key or seed phrase here.

Next: [find your Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/find-miner-id), then open [My devices](https://iotahome.site/en/app).

### IOTA Watch 是什么？它不是 IOTA 公链钱包

IOTA Watch 是面向 [IOTA Train at Home](https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/) 的独立网页监控工具。添加公开 Miner ID 后，可在同一页面查看上报的训练状态、今日记账收益和累计收益。

它**不是** IOTA Foundation 的 Layer 1 公链，也不是 IOTA 币钱包，更不是 Firefly。它不能转账、托管资金或签名交易。

## 功能范围

- 用公开 Miner ID（SS58 hotkey）查询官方上报数据

- 将多台设备放在同一份清单中，使用自定义名称区分

- 未登录可在浏览器保存最多 3 台，Google 登录后最多绑定 10 台

## 功能限制

- 不能启动或停止训练

- 不能读取设备上的 IOTA 应用日志

- 不能保证收益或到账时间

训练必须在每台设备的官方 Train at Home 应用中运行。官方说明见 [Macrocosmos TAH 用户指南](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide)。

## 搜索结果容易混淆的原因

搜索「IOTA」时，结果大多指向 IOTA 公链。IOTA Train at Home 是 Macrocosmos 在 Bittensor 生态中的去中心化训练产品。收益单位也称为 IOTA，但是子网 alpha 代币，不是 IOTA 公链币，也不是 TAO。对照见 [Train at Home 和 IOTA 公链的区别](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin)。

> 监控训练设备请使用 IOTA Watch。管理 IOTA 公链资产请使用对应官方钱包。请勿在本站填写私钥或助记词。

下一步：[获取 Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/find-miner-id)，然后打开 [我的设备](https://iotahome.site/zh/app)。


### How to find your IOTA Train at Home Miner ID
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/find-miner-id
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/find-miner-id
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

The Miner ID used by IOTA Watch is the public SS58 hotkey shown in the official Train at Home app. It is not a private key, seed phrase, coldkey, or a row number on this website.

## Copy it from the app

- Install Train at Home from [iota.macrocosmos.ai](https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/) if you have not already

- Launch the app and wait until it shows Connected

- Open **Miner** in the top left

- Copy the complete Miner ID

The official guide is here: [TAH user guide](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide).

## Add it to IOTA Watch

- Open the [dashboard](https://iotahome.site/en/app)

- Paste the full ID and give the device a name

- Repeat for each machine

Without signing in, the list stays in this browser (up to 3 devices). [Sign in with Google](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/google-account-device-list) to bind up to 10 and open the same list elsewhere. A JSON backup can still be exported.

> An incomplete ID will not match. If a device is “not found”, confirm that the full public address was copied.

After it is saved, see [device statuses](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-status) and [how rewards are counted](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work).

### 如何找到 IOTA Train at Home 的 Miner ID

IOTA Watch 使用的 Miner ID，是官方 Train at Home 应用里显示的公开 SS58 hotkey。它不是私钥、助记词、coldkey，也不是本站设备清单的行号。

## 从应用里复制

- 若尚未安装，请到 [iota.macrocosmos.ai](https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/) 下载 Train at Home

- 打开应用，待状态显示 Connected

- 选择左上角 **Miner**

- 复制完整的 Miner ID

官方步骤见 [TAH 用户指南](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide)。

## 添加到 IOTA Watch

- 打开 [我的设备](https://iotahome.site/zh/app)

- 粘贴完整 ID，并填写设备名称

- 每台设备分别添加一次

未登录时清单保存在当前浏览器（最多 3 台）。[使用 Google 登录](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/google-account-device-list) 后最多绑定 10 台，可在其他设备查看。仍可导出 JSON 备份。

> ID 不完整将无法匹配。若显示「尚未找到」，请核对是否复制了完整公开地址。

保存之后，可查看 [设备状态](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-status) 与 [收益计算](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)。


### How IOTA Train at Home daily and lifetime rewards are counted
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

IOTA Watch does not estimate earnings. It reads official entitlement records and shows two numbers: today’s accounted rewards, and lifetime accounted rewards.

## Today’s rewards

- Calendar day starts at 00:00 in Asia/Hong_Kong (UTC+8)

- Only records with status **pending** or **settled** are added

- Frozen and other statuses are excluded

- A timestamp after “now” is excluded

This is an accounting date. It does not mean the tokens arrived in a wallet today.

## Lifetime rewards

Lifetime uses **total earned** from the official totals API. Paid amounts are not added on top of earned, so the same reward is not counted twice.

## What the IOTA unit means here

On this site, IOTA is the Train at Home subnet alpha token used by the upstream API. It is not a TAO amount and not IOTA Layer 1. Next to each IOTA figure the dashboard also shows a USD estimate from the public SN9 market price. That estimate is not an official payout. Details: [how USD is shown](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/iota-rewards-in-usd).

## Missing values are not zero

If a request fails or the payload is unusable, the dashboard shows unknown — not 0. When only some devices have usable data, the total is marked partial (for example 2/3 devices).

> Numbers refresh on a cache: device status is usually kept for 60 seconds, rewards for five minutes. A manual refresh has a 15-second cooldown.

If a device appears idle, see [status meanings](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-status) before treating it as offline.

### IOTA Train at Home 今日收益和累计收益怎么算

IOTA Watch 不会估算收益。它读取官方 entitlements 记录，并给出两个数字：今日记账收益，以及累计记账收益。

## 今日收益

- 按香港时间（UTC+8）当天 00:00 起算

- 只加总状态为 **pending** 或 **settled** 的记录

- 冻结和其他状态不计入

- 时间戳晚于当前时刻的记录不计入

这是记账日口径，不代表代币今天已经打到钱包。

## 累计收益

累计收益取官方 totals 接口里的 **total earned**。不会再把已支付金额叠加上去，避免同一笔记两次。

## 这里的 IOTA 是什么单位

本站的 IOTA 是 Train at Home 上游接口使用的子网 alpha 代币。它不是 TAO，也不是 IOTA 公链币。每个 IOTA 数字旁边会同时给出按公开市场价格估算的美元，那不是官方结算价。详见 [收益怎么显示美元](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/iota-rewards-in-usd)。

## 缺失不是零

请求失败或数据不可用时，页面显示未知，不记作 0。只有部分设备有可用数据时，总计会标明覆盖范围，例如 2/3 台。

> 数据有缓存：设备状态通常保留 60 秒，收益保留 5 分钟。手动刷新有 15 秒冷却。

若设备显示未在训练，请先查看 [状态含义](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-status)，不宜直接视为离线。


### What IOTA Train at Home device statuses mean
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-status
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-status
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

IOTA Watch maps official miner records into a short status. The miner timestamp is the official **statistics sample time**. It is not a heartbeat from the device, and it is not the time this website last fetched data.

## Statuses

- **Contributing**: the latest official sample reports the device active with throughput above zero. That is reported activity, not a live guarantee that it is computing this second.

- **Waiting for tasks**: the device is reported active, but the latest sample has no throughput. It is often waiting to be assigned work.

- **Not participating**: the device is not reported as in the current training set. This does not prove it is offline or broken.

- **Not found**: every active run list was fetched successfully, and this Miner ID was not in them. Check the ID first.

- **Unknown / check later**: some run lists could not be fetched. Incomplete coverage is not a device fault.

## Two clocks, two meanings

If this website cannot refresh official data for more than five minutes, the dashboard says the refresh was interrupted and keeps the last successful values. That is a **fetch** problem. It is different from an old sample timestamp on a successful fetch. Details: [what “refresh interrupted” means](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means).

> Zero throughput is not evidence that the device is offline. For local errors, open the IOTA Train at Home app. This website cannot read local logs.

To add a device, see [how to find a Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/find-miner-id). For the numbers beside the status, see [how rewards are counted](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work).

### IOTA 设备状态含义：有贡献、等待任务、暂未参与

IOTA Watch 将官方 miner 记录归纳为简短状态。miner 时间戳是官方的**统计采样时间**，不是设备心跳，也不是本站最近一次拉取数据的时间。

## 状态说明

- **有贡献**：最近一次官方采样显示设备在线，且吞吐量大于 0。这是上报活动，不保证当前秒仍在计算。

- **等待任务**：设备被报为在线，但最近一次采样没有吞吐量。常见情况是等待分配任务。

- **暂未参与**：当前训练名单未将其计为正在参与。这不等于设备已离线或故障。

- **尚未找到**：所有进行中的训练任务名单均读取成功，其中没有该 Miner ID。请先核对 ID。

- **待确认**：部分任务名单本次未能读取。覆盖不完整，不代表设备故障。

## 两个时间，两件事情

如果本站超过 5 分钟都没能成功拿到官方数据，页面会提示刷新中断，并保留上一次成功的内容。那是**获取失败**。它和「这次获取成功，但官方采样时间比较旧」不是一回事。详见 [刷新中断是什么意思](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means)。

> 吞吐量为零，不等于设备已掉线。本机报错需在 IOTA Train at Home 应用中查看。本站无法读取设备本地日志。

添加设备见 [如何获取 Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/find-miner-id)。状态旁的数字见 [收益计算](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)。


### IOTA Train at Home vs the IOTA cryptocurrency
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

People searching for “IOTA” usually land on the IOTA Foundation Layer 1 cryptocurrency. **IOTA Train at Home** is a different product: a Macrocosmos training network in the Bittensor ecosystem. IOTA Watch only monitors the second one.

## Comparison

- **IOTA Train at Home**: home computers contribute training work. Rewards are the subnet alpha token, often called IOTA or SN9. A machine is identified with a public Miner ID (SS58 hotkey).

- **IOTA Layer 1**: a separate ledger and token. Wallets such as Firefly hold that coin. They do not show Train at Home device status.

- **IOTA Watch**: a read-only dashboard for Train at Home Miner IDs. It is not a wallet and does not ask for a seed phrase.

## Which to use

To see whether a device is contributing and what it earned today, use [IOTA Watch](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-is-iota-watch) and the official [Train at Home app](https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/). To hold or send IOTA Layer 1 coins, use that network’s official wallet — not this site.

> Do not paste a private key, recovery phrase, or coldkey secret into IOTA Watch. The Miner ID is a public address.

Next: [find the Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/find-miner-id), [what SN9 / IOTA means here](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-is-sn9-iota), then [how rewards are counted](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work).

### IOTA Train at Home 和 IOTA 公链有什么区别

搜索「IOTA」时，结果多半是 IOTA Foundation 的 Layer 1 公链。**IOTA Train at Home** 是另一项产品：Macrocosmos 在 Bittensor 生态中的训练网络。IOTA Watch 只监控后者。

## 对照

- **IOTA Train at Home**：设备贡献训练算力。收益是子网 alpha 代币，通常称为 IOTA 或 SN9。设备用公开 Miner ID（SS58 hotkey）识别。

- **IOTA 公链**：另一套账本和代币。Firefly 等钱包管理的是公链币，无法显示 Train at Home 设备状态。

- **IOTA Watch**：只读监控 Train at Home 的 Miner ID。不是钱包，也不会索取助记词。

## 如何选择

查看设备是否在贡献、今日收益，请使用 [IOTA Watch](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-is-iota-watch) 和官方 [Train at Home 应用](https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/)。持有或转出 IOTA 公链币，请使用该链官方钱包，不要使用本站。

> 请勿在 IOTA Watch 中填写私钥、助记词或 coldkey 密钥。Miner ID 是公开地址。

下一步：[获取 Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/find-miner-id)，了解 [SN9 / IOTA](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-is-sn9-iota)，然后查看 [收益计算](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)。


### How IOTA Train at Home rewards are shown in USD
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/iota-rewards-in-usd
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/iota-rewards-in-usd
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

The dashboard shows **two numbers for the same reward**: the official IOTA amount from Train at Home entitlements, and an estimated USD value beside it.

## What is official

Today’s and lifetime IOTA amounts still follow the [reward rules](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work): Hong Kong midnight, pending and settled only, lifetime = total earned. IOTA Watch does not invent those IOTA figures.

## What is an estimate

The USD line multiplies that IOTA amount by a public market price for the Train at Home subnet token (SN9 / CoinGecko `iota-2`). It is **not** the IOTA Foundation Layer 1 price, not TAO, and not a promise that you can sell at that rate.

## When USD is a dash

If the market feed is down, IOTA amounts stay visible and USD shows unknown. Missing price is not treated as $0.

> Use the IOTA number for official accounting. Use USD only as a rough scale.

If this token is still being mixed up with IOTA Layer 1, see [Train at Home vs the IOTA coin](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin).

### IOTA Train at Home 收益怎么同时显示美元

监控页对同一笔收益会给出**两个数字**：官方 entitlements 里的 IOTA 数量，以及旁边估算的美元。

## 哪些是官方口径

今日和累计的 IOTA 数量仍按 [收益规则](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)：香港时间 0 点、只计 pending 和 settled，累计取 total earned。IOTA Watch 不会自行生成这些 IOTA 数字。

## 哪些只是估价

美元一行，是用上述 IOTA 数量乘以 Train at Home 子网代币（SN9 / CoinGecko `iota-2`）的公开市场价格。它**不是** IOTA 公链币价，不是 TAO，也不保证你能按这个价格卖出。

## 美元变成横线时

行情接口不可用时，IOTA 数量照常显示，美元显示未知。没有价格不会当成 $0。

> 核对账目请以 IOTA 为准。美元仅用于参考量级。

如与 IOTA 公链混淆，请先阅读 [Train at Home 和 IOTA 公链的区别](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin)。


### What “refresh interrupted” means on IOTA Watch
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

**Refresh interrupted** appears when this website cannot complete a successful read of official Train at Home data for more than five minutes. The cards keep the last values that did arrive.

It is a **website fetch** status. It is not a device heartbeat, and it is not the official statistics sample time.

## What it is not

- Not “the device stopped training”

- Not “throughput is zero, so the device is offline”

- Not the same as [Not found](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-not-found), which means the Miner ID was missing from a complete run list

## What you can still trust

IOTA amounts that already loaded are the last official entitlements this site received. USD beside them is only a public SN9 estimate. See [how rewards are counted](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work).

## What to do

- Wait for the next automatic check, or tap refresh once (there is a short cooldown)

- If the yellow notice names an upstream error, the official API was unreachable from this site

- For local errors — app disconnected, GPU idle, login failed — open the Train at Home app on that machine. IOTA Watch cannot read local logs

> After a successful fetch, the badge should return to contributing, waiting, or not participating. Read those here: [device statuses](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-status).

### IOTA Watch「刷新中断」是什么意思

**刷新中断**出现在本站超过 5 分钟都没能成功读完官方 Train at Home 数据时。卡片会保留上一次已经拿到的数字。

这是**网站获取**状态，不是设备心跳，也不是官方统计采样时间。

## 它不是什么

- 不是「设备已经停止训练」

- 不是「吞吐量为零，所以设备掉线了」

- 也不同于 [尚未找到](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-not-found)：那是完整名单里没有这个 Miner ID

## 哪些数字还能看

已经显示出来的 IOTA 数量，是本站上次拿到的官方 entitlements。旁边的美元只是 SN9 公开市场估价。口径见 [收益怎么算](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)。

## 处理方式

- 等待下一轮自动检查，或点击一次刷新（有短暂冷却）

- 若黄色提示写明上游错误，表示本站当时无法连接官方接口

- 本机报错（应用断连、GPU 空闲、登录失败）请在该设备上打开 Train at Home 应用。IOTA Watch 无法读取本地日志

> 获取成功后，徽章应回到有贡献、等待任务或暂未参与。对照见 [设备状态含义](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-status)。


### How Google sign-in stores your IOTA Watch device list
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/google-account-device-list
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/google-account-device-list
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

Google sign-in on IOTA Watch only binds a **list of public Miner IDs and labels**. It is not a wallet login and never asks for a password, private key, or seed phrase.

## Without signing in

- This browser can keep up to **3** devices

- The list lives in local storage on this machine

- Another phone or computer will not see it unless you export and import a JSON backup

## After Google sign-in

- The same account can keep up to **10** devices

- Open [Account](https://iotahome.site/en/account) to see the name, email, and avatar Google provided

- Add, rename, and remove devices on the [dashboard](https://iotahome.site/en/app)

- Sign in on another device to see the same list

## What is stored

Public SS58 hotkeys, labels you typed, and when you added them. Telemetry is fetched from official public APIs. Details: [privacy notes](https://iotahome.site/en/privacy).

> Signing out does not delete the official training history. It only disconnects this browser from the bound list.

To obtain an ID, see [how to find a Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/find-miner-id).

### IOTA Watch 用 Google 登录后，设备清单怎么同步

IOTA Watch 的 Google 登录只绑定**公开 Miner ID 和设备名称**。这不是钱包登录，不需要密码、私钥或助记词。

## 未登录时

- 当前浏览器最多保存 **3** 台

- 清单位于该设备的本地存储

- 其他设备无法查看，除非导出 JSON 后再导入

## Google 登录后

- 同一账号最多绑定 **10** 台

- 打开 [账号页](https://iotahome.site/zh/account) 可查看 Google 提供的姓名、邮箱和头像

- 添加、改名、移除均在 [我的设备](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) 完成

- 在其他设备登录同一账号即可查看同一份清单

## 存储内容

公开的 SS58 hotkey、设备名称，以及添加时间。状态和收益来自官方公开接口。详见 [隐私说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/privacy)。

> 退出登录不会删除官方训练记录，仅使当前浏览器不再读取已绑定的清单。

获取 ID 见 [如何获取 Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/find-miner-id)。


### What SN9 / IOTA means on Train at Home
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-is-sn9-iota
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-is-sn9-iota
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

Train at Home rewards are denominated in the subnet’s **alpha token**. People call it IOTA or **SN9**. IOTA Watch uses the same unit the official entitlements API returns.

## SN9 in one line

SN9 is Bittensor subnet 9 — Macrocosmos IOTA Train at Home. The CoinGecko id for that token is `iota-2`. Do not use the Layer 1 id `iota`.

## What it is not

- Not **TAO**, the Bittensor parent token

- Not the **IOTA Foundation** Layer 1 coin used by Firefly

- Not a dollar payout. USD on the dashboard is a public-market estimate only

If search results keep sending you to the wrong IOTA, read [Train at Home vs the IOTA coin](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin).

## How IOTA Watch uses it

Today and lifetime figures stay in official IOTA amounts. The USD line multiplies those amounts by a public SN9 price. Missing price shows a dash, never $0. Details: [USD estimates](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/iota-rewards-in-usd) and [reward rules](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work).

> IOTA Watch cannot send, swap, or custody this token. It only displays official accounted amounts.

### Train at Home 的 SN9 / IOTA 是什么代币

Train at Home 的收益单位是子网 **alpha 代币**，通常称为 IOTA 或 **SN9**。IOTA Watch 使用官方 entitlements 接口返回的同一单位。

## SN9 说明

SN9 是 Bittensor 子网 9，即 Macrocosmos 的 IOTA Train at Home。该代币在 CoinGecko 上的 id 是 `iota-2`，请勿使用公链的 `iota`。

## 排除项

- 不是 **TAO**（Bittensor 主网代币）

- 不是 **IOTA Foundation** 公链币，也不是 Firefly 中的 IOTA

- 不是美元结算。监控页上的 USD 仅为公开市场估价

若搜索结果指向另一条 IOTA，请先阅读 [Train at Home 和 IOTA 公链的区别](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/iota-train-at-home-vs-iota-coin)。

## IOTA Watch 的用法

今日和累计数字保持官方 IOTA 数量。美元一行按公开 SN9 价格折算。没有行情则显示横线，不记作 $0。详见 [美元估价](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/iota-rewards-in-usd) 和 [收益规则](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)。

> IOTA Watch 不能发送、兑换或托管这种代币，只展示官方记账数量。


### IOTA Watch says the Miner ID was not found
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-not-found
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-not-found
- Published: 2026-09-12
- Updated: 2026-09-12
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

**Not found** is only used after IOTA Watch successfully reads every active Train at Home run list and still does not see this Miner ID.

That is different from [refresh interrupted](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means) (this site could not finish the fetch) and from [unknown / check later](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-status) (some lists failed, so we cannot judge).

## Check the ID first

- Copy the complete public Miner ID from the official app’s Miner screen

- It is an SS58 hotkey, usually starting with `5`

- Do not paste a private key, seed phrase, coldkey secret, or a row number from this website

Steps: [how to find your Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/find-miner-id).

## Other common reasons

- The app is installed but the miner is not registered or not yet on any active run

- You copied an old ID after reinstalling the app

- A character was truncated when pasting

> Training still has to run in the official app. IOTA Watch cannot register a miner or start a job for you.

If the ID is correct and a fetch succeeds, the card should move to contributing, waiting, or not participating. Those meanings: [device statuses](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-status).

### IOTA Watch 显示「尚未找到」

**尚未找到**只会在 IOTA Watch 已经成功读完所有进行中的 Train at Home 任务名单，而且里面仍然没有这个 Miner ID 时出现。

它不同于 [刷新中断](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means)（本站没读完），也不同于 [待确认](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-status)（部分名单失败，暂时无法判断）。

## 核对 ID

- 从官方应用的 Miner 页面复制完整公开 Miner ID

- 它是 SS58 hotkey，通常以 `5` 开头

- 请勿粘贴私钥、助记词、coldkey 密钥，或本站清单的行号

步骤见 [如何获取 Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/find-miner-id)。

## 其他常见原因

- 应用已安装，但矿工尚未注册，或尚未出现在任何进行中的任务中

- 重装应用后仍使用旧 ID

- 粘贴时截断了一个字符

> 训练仍须在官方应用中运行。IOTA Watch 不能注册矿工或开始任务。

ID 正确且获取成功后，卡片应变成有贡献、等待任务或暂未参与。含义见 [设备状态](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-status)。


### Where IOTA Watch data comes from and how often it refreshes
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/data-sources-and-freshness
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/data-sources-and-freshness
- Published: 2026-10-01
- Updated: 2026-10-01
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

IOTA Watch reads the public Macrocosmos mainnet API. Device status, rewards and training statistics have separate update clocks; refreshing one does not make the others current.

## Which sources feed each view?

- Device discovery: active runs and the miner roster for every active run

- Network view: runs, run occupancy, miner rosters and run progress

- Rewards: entitlement totals and reward history, fetched independently

- Training history: metrics, throughput and cumulative tokens for the selected run and period

The API base is [iota-web.api.macrocosmos.ai/mainnet](https://iota-web.api.macrocosmos.ai/mainnet/runs). These are public readings; IOTA Watch cannot read local device logs or control the official training app.

## How often does the page update?

While the page is visible, device status normally checks every 30 seconds and rewards every two minutes. Network miner rosters and progress check about once a minute. Server caches last 60 seconds for miner rosters and progress, 120 seconds for occupancy, and five minutes for runs, rewards and historical metrics. Repeated page checks may reuse a valid cached response.

Manual refresh has a 15-second cooldown. It can request newer data, but still respects official rate limits and retry delays. Background polling pauses while the page is hidden.

## Fetch time versus sample time

Fetch time records the last successful read of that source. Sample time is when the official API recorded a training statistic. A successful read can contain an old sample; that alone does not show a machine is offline.

## What happens when a source fails?

Previous successful values remain visible with a warning and their original fetch time. Missing data stays unknown. Reward totals and reward history can fail separately, so one usable field does not imply that every reward field is current.

A device refresh interrupted for more than five minutes is a data-read warning. See [refresh interrupted](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means). A [partial network view](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/network-status-explained) reports the number of rosters successfully read.

### IOTA Watch 数据来自哪里，多久更新一次？

IOTA Watch 读取 Macrocosmos 的公开主网 API。设备状态、收益与训练统计分别记录更新时间；某一项刷新成功，不会让其他项目自动变成最新。

## 各页面使用哪些数据源？

- 设备查找：进行中的任务，以及每个任务的矿工名单

- 全网现况：任务列表、网络名额、矿工名单和任务进度

- 收益：分别读取记账总额与收益历史记录

- 训练历史：所选任务与时间范围内的训练指标、吞吐量和累计 token 数

API 基础地址是 [iota-web.api.macrocosmos.ai/mainnet](https://iota-web.api.macrocosmos.ai/mainnet/runs)。这些是公开上报数据，本站无法读取设备本地日志或控制官方训练应用。

## 页面多久更新一次？

页面可见时，设备状态通常每 30 秒检查一次，收益每 2 分钟检查一次；全网矿工名单与进度约每分钟检查一次。服务端对矿工名单与进度缓存 60 秒，网络名额缓存 120 秒，任务列表、收益和历史指标缓存 5 分钟。多次检查可能复用仍有效的缓存结果。

手动刷新有 15 秒冷却，可请求较新的数据，但仍遵守官方限流和重试等待。页面隐藏时暂停后台轮询。

## 拉取时间与采样时间有什么区别？

拉取时间是该数据源最近一次成功读取的时间；采样时间是官方记录训练统计的时间。成功读取也可能返回较旧的采样，不能仅据此判断机器离线。

## 接口失败后会发生什么？

上次成功的数据会保留，并显示警告和原来的拉取时间。缺失数据仍为未知。收益总额与收益记录可能分别失败，因此一个字段可用，不代表所有收益数据都是最新。

设备数据超过 5 分钟没能成功更新，会提示读取中断。详见 [刷新中断说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means)。[全网数据不完整](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/network-status-explained) 时会注明成功读取了多少份名单。
- Source: Macrocosmos · Train at Home — https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH user guide — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide
- Source: IOTA Watch · source code — https://github.com/molimao/iota

### How to read IOTA Train at Home training history and throughput
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/training-history-and-metrics
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/training-history-and-metrics
- Published: 2026-10-01
- Updated: 2026-10-01
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

Open a saved device’s details, select a training run, then choose day, week or month. The chart and table show official historical samples for that selection. Training volume is not a token payout or a reward forecast.

## Which metrics can I compare?

- Tokens: reported training token count for an epoch

- Throughput: processing rate reported by the official history API

- Cumulative tokens: the cumulative training token count, separate from lifetime rewards

- Contribution: the reported fraction displayed as a percentage; 0.02 displays as 2%

- Rank and participants: the reported position and participant count for that epoch, when available

Switch the chart between tokens, throughput and cumulative tokens. The table preserves the individual samples so the trend can be checked against the numbers.

## Why can the chart have gaps?

The three history sources may contain different epochs. IOTA Watch joins values by epoch instead of assuming the array positions line up. A missing measurement is a gap, not an invented zero.

## Why is the selected run empty?

The official API may have no samples for this Miner ID in the chosen run or period. Check the task selection, try another period and inspect source warnings. An empty history does not prove that the device has failed.

For current activity, read [device status](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-status). For accounted tokens, read [how rewards work](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work). [Data freshness](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/data-sources-and-freshness) explains why recent retrieval can still contain older samples.

### IOTA Train at Home 训练历史、吞吐量与贡献率怎么看？

打开已保存设备的详情，选择训练任务，再切换日、周或月。趋势图和表格展示所选范围内的官方历史采样。训练量不是代币到账金额，也不是未来收益预测。

## 可以对比哪些指标？

- Tokens：某个 epoch 上报的训练 token 数

- 吞吐量：官方历史接口上报的处理速率

- 累计 tokens：累计训练 token 数，与累计收益分开计算

- 贡献率：把上报的比例显示为百分比，例如 0.02 显示为 2%

- 排名与参与人数：该 epoch 上报的名次及参与人数，有数据时才展示

趋势图可切换训练量、吞吐量或累计训练量。下方表格保留每次采样，便于对照图形与具体数字。

## 为什么曲线会有空缺？

三个历史数据源可能包含不同的 epoch。本站按 epoch 对齐数据，不假定数组中的相同位置属于同一次训练。缺失的测量值保留为空缺，不补成 0。

## 为什么所选任务没有历史？

官方 API 可能尚未提供该 Miner ID 在所选任务或时间范围内的采样。请核对任务选择，切换时间范围，并查看数据源警告。历史为空不能直接证明设备故障。

当前活动看 [设备状态](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-status)，记账代币看 [收益口径](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)。[数据时效说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/data-sources-and-freshness) 解释了为什么刚拉取的数据仍可能包含旧采样。
- Source: Macrocosmos · Train at Home — https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH user guide — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide
- Source: IOTA Watch · source code — https://github.com/molimao/iota

### IOTA Train at Home network status: slots, online miners and training progress
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/network-status-explained
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/learn/network-status-explained
- Published: 2026-10-01
- Updated: 2026-10-01
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

The [network page](https://iotahome.site/en/network) shows public IOTA Train at Home runs without requiring a Miner ID or sign-in. It gives context for your device: which runs exist, their available slots and the activity reported by the network.

## Online is different from training

Online counts come from the retrieved miner rosters. Training counts reflect miners with reported training activity. A roster can contain miners waiting for work; those counts do not have to match. They are not the number of people using IOTA Watch.

## How should I read slots and progress?

Slots come from official run occupancy. Progress and loss describe the whole run, not one device. Available capacity does not guarantee assignment, and the monitoring site cannot allocate a slot.

## What does roster coverage mean?

Coverage compares successfully refreshed miner lists with the runs being checked. For example, 7/8 means one list could not be refreshed. The totals may be incomplete; a failed list is not counted as zero miners. Global miner totals deduplicate public hotkeys across retrieved runs.

Each source has its own retrieval time. Inspect [source freshness](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/data-sources-and-freshness) before comparing snapshots. Older successful values are retained with warnings when an update fails.

## Where should I check my own machine?

Add its public Miner ID on [My devices](https://iotahome.site/en/app). For missing devices, follow [device not found](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/device-not-found). Open the official app for local errors; the network page cannot inspect your Mac.

### IOTA Train at Home 全网状态：名额、在线矿工与训练进度

[全网页面](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) 无需 Miner ID 或登录，即可查看 IOTA Train at Home 的公开任务。它提供设备状态的背景：有哪些任务、还剩多少名额，以及网络上报的活动情况。

## 在线与训练人数有什么区别？

在线人数来自已获取的矿工名单，训练人数反映有上报训练活动的矿工。名单里可能包含等待任务的矿工，两者不必相同。这些数字也不是 IOTA Watch 的用户人数。

## 名额和进度应怎样理解？

名额来自官方任务占用数据。进度与损失描述整个任务，不是单台设备。存在空位不保证立即分配任务，本站也无法分配名额。

## 名单覆盖率是什么意思？

覆盖率比较成功刷新的矿工名单数与正在检查的任务数。例如 7/8 表示一份名单没能更新，总量可能不完整；不会把失败的名单当成 0 个矿工。全网矿工总量会对已获取任务里的公开 hotkey 去重。

各来源分别记录拉取时间。对照数据前，请先检查 [数据时效](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/data-sources-and-freshness)。刷新失败时，较旧的成功数据会保留并附上警告。

## 怎样检查自己的机器？

在 [我的设备](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) 添加公开 Miner ID。设备缺失时，按 [尚未找到设备的排查步骤](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/device-not-found) 检查。本地错误请打开官方应用，全网页面无法读取 Mac 的本地状态。
- Source: Macrocosmos · Train at Home — https://iota.macrocosmos.ai/
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH user guide — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide
- Source: IOTA Watch · source code — https://github.com/molimao/iota

### How to monitor multiple IOTA Train at Home devices from one browser
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/blog/monitor-multiple-iota-devices
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/blog/monitor-multiple-iota-devices
- Published: 2026-10-01
- Updated: 2026-10-01
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

When several Macs run IOTA Train at Home, opening each machine’s app is useful for local checks but inconvenient for a quick overview. IOTA Watch brings public device readings into one browser: reported activity, reward totals and training history. Training continues in the official app on each Mac; the browser is a monitor, not a remote control.

## Start with a separate Miner ID for each machine

Copy the public Miner ID from each device’s official Miner screen. The [Macrocosmos FAQ](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/faqs) distinguishes a device’s hotkey from the coldkey used for payouts: devices have different hotkeys even when they share a payout address. Adding the same ID twice does not monitor two machines.

- Open [My devices](https://iotahome.site/en/app) and add the complete Miner ID

- Give it a name that identifies the machine, such as its room or your existing inventory label

- Repeat on the other Macs and check each name against its source machine

Do not rely on the first few address characters to distinguish devices. Naming the list reduces mistakes when reviewing a machine that is waiting or renaming a device later.

## Choose where the list should live

Without signing in, IOTA Watch stores up to three devices in the current browser. This is convenient for checking a small setup on one computer. A different browser or phone will not automatically receive that local list; clearing browser storage can remove it.

Google sign-in supports up to ten devices in an account-bound list. Use the same Google account when opening the monitor elsewhere. Check the list after switching accounts or signing out: the local and signed-in storage modes are different. The [account and device-list guide](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/google-account-device-list) explains the product limits and storage behavior.

## Read the overview in a consistent order

Start with the data-source ages and warnings. Then filter device statuses to narrow down machines worth checking. An old official sample, waiting state or zero throughput is not enough to conclude that a Mac has disconnected.

Review rewards after checking coverage. When only some devices have usable earnings data, the aggregate is marked partial. That total represents the known devices; it should not be compared with a fully covered total as though both represent the same fleet.

- For a waiting device, compare its run with the [network view](https://iotahome.site/en/network)

- For a device absent from a complete scan, check its full ID and official app

- For one unusual trend, open device details and select the relevant run and time range

## Keep a portable backup

Export the device list as JSON before changing browsers or clearing site data. Import and export move public IDs and names; they do not migrate local training sessions, wallet credentials or payout settings. Store the file where you can retrieve it and verify the restored names after import.

A useful routine is simple: check freshness, review exceptions, inspect reward coverage, then open the official app only where a local check is needed. Start with [finding a Miner ID](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/find-miner-id) and the [data freshness guide](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/data-sources-and-freshness).

### 多台 Mac 跑 IOTA Train at Home，怎样集中查看状态和收益？

多台 Mac 同时运行 IOTA Train at Home 时，逐台打开官方应用适合检查本地问题，却不方便快速了解全局。IOTA Watch 把设备的公开上报状态、收益与训练历史集中到一个浏览器中。训练仍在每台 Mac 的官方应用里运行，网页提供监控，不提供远程控制。

## 每台机器使用自己的 Miner ID

分别在每台设备的官方 Miner 页面复制公开 Miner ID。[Macrocosmos FAQ](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/faqs) 区分设备 hotkey 与收款 coldkey：即使多台设备使用相同的收款地址，设备 hotkey 仍各不相同。重复添加同一个 ID，不会变成监控两台机器。

- 打开 [我的设备](https://iotahome.site/zh/app)，添加完整 Miner ID

- 用房间名称或已有资产编号给设备命名，方便辨认

- 在其余 Mac 上重复操作，核对名称是否对应正确机器

不要只用地址开头几个字符区分设备。清晰的名称能减少查看等待任务的机器、重命名或移除设备时的误操作。

## 清单应该保存在浏览器还是账号里？

未登录时，IOTA Watch 最多在当前浏览器保存 3 台设备，适合在一台电脑上查看小规模设备清单。换浏览器或用手机打开时，原来的本地清单不会自动出现；清除浏览器数据也可能移除清单。

使用 Google 登录后，可在账号清单中绑定最多 10 台设备。换设备查看时，请登录相同 Google 账号。切换账号或退出登录后，要再次确认当前清单：本地模式与登录模式使用不同的保存方式。详见 [账号与设备清单说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/google-account-device-list)。

## 按固定顺序读设备概览

先检查数据源更新时间和警告，再用状态筛选缩小需要检查的机器范围。官方采样较旧、正在等待任务或吞吐量为零，都不足以单独证明 Mac 已断开连接。

查看收益时，先确认数据覆盖率。只有部分设备的收益可用时，合计会标为「部分」。它代表已知设备的收益，不应直接与覆盖全部机器的合计比较，认为两者描述了相同设备范围。

- 设备在等待任务时，对照其任务与 [全网现况](https://iotahome.site/zh/network)

- 完整扫描仍未找到设备时，核对完整 ID 并检查官方应用

- 单台设备趋势异常时，打开详情，选择对应任务与时间范围

## 给清单留一份可迁移备份

更换浏览器或清除站点数据前，先导出 JSON 清单。导入导出迁移的是公开 ID 与设备名称，不会迁移本地训练会话、钱包凭据或收款设置。把文件保存在便于找回的位置，导入后再次核对名称。

日常检查可以按同一顺序完成：确认数据时效、查看需要关注的设备、核对收益覆盖率，最后对确有本地问题的机器打开官方应用。初次使用可先读 [Miner ID 获取步骤](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/find-miner-id) 和 [数据时效说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/data-sources-and-freshness)。
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH support and FAQs — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/faqs
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH user guide — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide
- Source: IOTA Watch · source code — https://github.com/molimao/iota

### IOTA Train at Home rewards are zero or unpaid: what to check first
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/blog/iota-rewards-zero-or-not-paid
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/blog/iota-rewards-zero-or-not-paid
- Published: 2026-10-01
- Updated: 2026-10-01
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

A zero on the dashboard and a missing wallet payout are different questions. The first concerns the records the monitor can read; the second concerns official payout processing. Before restarting training or assuming rewards were lost, identify which field changed and whether its data source succeeded.

## First distinguish zero from unknown

IOTA Watch shows a known zero only when a usable official response supports it. A failed request, invalid response or missing field remains unknown. If a refresh fails, a previous successful reading may stay visible with its original timestamp and a warning.

Open the device’s reward details and inspect totals and history separately. Lifetime totals can be available while the history request fails, or the reverse. A partly available reward panel does not make every number current. Check [data freshness](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/data-sources-and-freshness) before comparing two screenshots taken at different times.

## Check which day the total covers

Today’s rewards in IOTA Watch use the Hong Kong calendar day, starting at 00:00 Asia/Hong_Kong. They sum official pending and settled history entries in that window, excluding frozen entries and future timestamps. The result is accounted earnings, not an estimate of how much the machine is earning this second.

After midnight, today’s reading can be zero while lifetime earnings remain positive. Look at the history record timestamps before treating that as a regression. A device in a different timezone still uses the same dashboard accounting day. The [reward calculation guide](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/how-rewards-work) describes this rule in detail.

## Earned, pending and paid answer different questions

Lifetime earned describes the official amount credited overall. Paid describes what the official totals endpoint reports as paid. Pending describes a balance awaiting payment. Adding paid to earned would count part of the reward twice; IOTA Watch keeps those fields separate.

The [official FAQ](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/faqs) describes a changing payout threshold and conditions that can freeze entitlements. Use the current balance and minimum-payout fields returned by the official API instead of relying on an old numeric threshold from a post. A pending or frozen record is not a confirmed wallet receipt.

## Check coverage before comparing several devices

If one device has no usable history, a fleet’s today total is incomplete even when other devices are readable. The dashboard marks the known total as partial. An increase in the number of readable devices can increase the total without showing a sudden change in training performance.

- Confirm the saved ID is the device’s public Miner ID

- Check the official app’s earnings view alongside the web monitor

- Record which field is missing, its source warning and the last successful fetch time

- For a payout issue, check settings in the official app and consult official support

## Keep the monitor and payout setup separate

IOTA Watch does not configure where the official app pays rewards, move tokens or verify a wallet transaction. A Google account synchronizes a device list; it does not change a payout address. For reported activity with no recent training volume, continue with [waiting-for-task checks](https://iotahome.site/en/blog/iota-waiting-for-tasks).

### IOTA Train at Home 收益为零或没到账，先检查什么？

监控页显示 0 与钱包没有收到代币，是两个不同的问题。前者涉及网页读到了哪些记录，后者涉及官方支付流程。重启训练或判断收益丢失前，先确认变化的是哪个字段，以及对应数据源是否成功更新。

## 先区分零值与未知

IOTA Watch 只有在可用的官方响应支持零值时才显示已知的 0。请求失败、响应格式异常或字段缺失会保留为未知。刷新失败后，上次成功读取的数值可能继续显示，同时保留原更新时间并附上警告。

打开设备的收益详情，分别检查总额与历史记录。累计收益可能可用，而历史请求失败；也可能相反。收益面板部分可用，不代表其中所有数字都是最新。比较不同时间的截图前，先看 [数据时效说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/data-sources-and-freshness)。

## 确认今日收益属于哪一天

本站的今日收益按香港时间每天 00:00 起算，累加该时间窗口内官方历史中的 pending 与 settled 记录，排除 frozen 及未来时间戳。它是记账收益，不是对机器当前每秒收益的估算。

跨过午夜后，今日收益可以为 0，而累计收益仍为正。先检查收益记录的时间，再判断是否出现异常。即使机器位于其他时区，网页也使用同一记账日口径。详细规则见 [收益计算说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/how-rewards-work)。

## 已赚取、待支付与已支付分别说明什么？

累计已赚取描述官方已记入的总额；已支付描述官方 totals 接口报告的支付金额；待支付描述等待支付的余额。把已支付再加到累计已赚取上，会把一部分收益重复计算，因此本站分别展示这些字段。

[官方 FAQ](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/faqs) 说明支付门槛会变化，某些条件下记账权益可能被冻结。请以官网 API 当前返回的余额和最低支付字段为准，不要把旧文章里的固定门槛当成现行规则。pending 或 frozen 记录也不是钱包已收到代币的凭证。

## 比较多台设备前先检查覆盖率

某台设备的历史不可用时，即使其他设备可读，全队列的今日合计仍不完整。网页会把已知总额标为「部分」。可读设备数量增加后，总额也可能上升，这不等于训练表现突然提高。

- 确认清单里保存的是该设备的公开 Miner ID

- 对照官方应用中的收益页面与网页监控

- 记录缺失字段、数据源警告和最近成功读取时间

- 收款问题请检查官方应用设置，并参考官方支持说明

## 监控清单与收款设置分开处理

IOTA Watch 不配置官方应用的收款地址，不转移代币，也不验证钱包交易。Google 账号用于同步设备清单，不会改变收款地址。若设备有上报状态却没有近期训练量，可继续查看 [等待任务的排查步骤](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog/iota-waiting-for-tasks)。
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH support and FAQs — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/faqs
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH user guide — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide
- Source: IOTA Watch · source code — https://github.com/molimao/iota

### IOTA Train at Home waiting for tasks: how to investigate zero throughput
- ZH: https://iotahome.site/zh/blog/iota-waiting-for-tasks
- EN: https://iotahome.site/en/blog/iota-waiting-for-tasks
- Published: 2026-10-01
- Updated: 2026-10-01
- Publisher: IOTA Watch (independent monitor)

A device can appear in the official miner list while its latest reported throughput is zero. That snapshot is not enough to identify a hardware failure or a lost connection. A useful investigation separates three things: whether the website refreshed, what the official network reported, and what the local training app is doing.

## Check whether the website has current source data

Look at the device status source age and any refresh warning first. If the website has not successfully refreshed that source for more than five minutes, IOTA Watch marks the refresh interrupted and retains the prior readings. This indicates a data-read problem; it does not establish that the Mac stopped training.

A newer earnings timestamp does not renew a device status timestamp. Different sources can succeed independently. Manual refresh has a cooldown and still respects official rate limits, so repeatedly clicking it is not a reliable way to obtain a new sample. See [refresh interrupted](https://iotahome.site/en/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means).

## Read the status as a reported sample

IOTA Watch uses official miner data to distinguish reported contribution, waiting and non-participation. Throughput belongs to a statistics sample, not a live heartbeat. Check the sample timestamp separately from the time the browser fetched that response.

If every active roster was read successfully and an ID is absent, check the full saved Miner ID. If roster coverage is incomplete, an unknown result cannot establish absence. Renaming a device changes its label, not the public ID used for discovery.

## Compare the device with its current run

Open the [network page](https://iotahome.site/en/network) and find the run associated with the device. Read roster coverage, slots, reported training counts and progress together. A slot reading does not guarantee immediate assignment, and run-wide progress is not the progress of one Mac.

A network snapshot gives context, but it does not explain every local issue. Two devices can be in different runs, and two sources can have different fetch times. Avoid comparing their numbers as if they were synchronized measurements.

## Use history to see whether there is a recent pattern

Open device details, select the relevant task and inspect a day or week of throughput and training tokens. Compare several samples rather than one point. History sources are joined by epoch; missing values stay gaps instead of being filled with zero.

An empty selected history may mean the API has no records for that task and period. Try a different period, verify the run selection and check source warnings. Neither an empty chart nor a high ranking establishes how much a device should be paid.

## Then make the local checks

The [official user guide](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide) identifies the app’s readiness status, run panel, run log and update notices as local checks. Open the affected Mac’s app and inspect those views; the monitor cannot read them remotely.

- Check the app’s displayed connection and training state

- Note the run ID and any visible error or update notice

- Compare those observations with the browser’s last successful readings

- Use official support when the local app reports an error you cannot resolve

Keep the observation precise: “the current sample reports zero throughput” is more useful than assuming the machine is offline. For rewards that look inconsistent with activity, read [zero or unpaid rewards](https://iotahome.site/en/blog/iota-rewards-zero-or-not-paid).

### IOTA Train at Home 一直等待任务、吞吐量为零，怎样排查？

设备可能仍出现在官方矿工名单中，但最近一次上报的吞吐量为零。单凭这一张快照，无法确认硬件故障或连接中断。排查时可以分开看三件事：网页有没有成功刷新、官方网络上报了什么，以及本地训练应用正在做什么。

## 先确认网页拿到了较新的数据

先看设备状态来源的更新时间与刷新警告。该来源超过 5 分钟没有成功刷新时，IOTA Watch 会标记刷新中断，并保留旧数值。这说明数据读取遇到问题，不足以证明 Mac 已停止训练。

收益更新时间变新，不会让设备状态的时间自动变新。不同来源可能分别成功或失败。手动刷新有冷却时间，也遵守官方限流，连续点击并不能保证得到新采样。详见 [刷新中断说明](https://iotahome.site/zh/learn/what-refresh-interrupted-means)。

## 把状态理解为一次上报采样

本站根据官方 miner 数据区分有贡献、等待与暂未参与。吞吐量属于统计采样，不是实时心跳。请分别检查采样时间与浏览器拉取该响应的时间。

只有完整读取所有进行中任务的名单后，仍找不到某个 ID，才应进一步核对保存的完整 Miner ID。名单覆盖不完整时，未知状态不能证明设备缺席。重命名只改变显示名称，不改变用于查找的公开 ID。

## 对照设备所处任务的全网情况

打开 [全网现况](https://iotahome.site/zh/network)，找到设备对应任务，结合名单覆盖率、名额、训练人数和进度一起看。名额数据不保证立即分配任务，任务整体进度也不是这台 Mac 的单机进度。

网络快照提供背景，但不能解释每一个本地问题。两台设备可能处于不同任务，不同数据源也可能在不同时间成功拉取。对比数字时，不要默认它们来自完全同步的测量。

## 用历史判断是否形成持续现象

打开设备详情，选择对应任务，检查一天或一周的吞吐量与训练 token 数。对照多次采样比只看一个点更有帮助。历史数据按 epoch 对齐，缺失值保留为空缺，不填成 0。

所选历史为空，可能是 API 没有提供这个任务和时间范围的记录。可以切换范围、核对任务选择并查看来源警告。空图表或较高排名，都不能单独推出设备应该获得多少收益。

## 最后进行本地检查

[官方用户指南](https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide) 将应用就绪状态、任务面板、运行日志及更新提示列为可查看的本地信息。请在对应 Mac 上打开应用检查，网页无法远程读取这些信息。

- 检查应用显示的连接状态与训练状态

- 记下 run ID，以及可见错误或更新提示

- 将本地观察与网页最近成功读取的结果对照

- 本地错误无法解决时，参考官方支持渠道

描述问题时，使用「最近一次采样上报吞吐量为零」比直接判断机器离线更准确。若活动状态与收益看起来不一致，可继续读 [收益为零或未到账的检查步骤](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog/iota-rewards-zero-or-not-paid)。
- Source: Macrocosmos · TAH user guide — https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/product-and-services/tah/tah-user-guide
- Source: IOTA Watch · source code — https://github.com/molimao/iota
